context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 配線/一周/進め方/納入/現職/心構え/立ち上がる/取り組ま

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、配線図、読める社員、貴重だ。
lines.en: Ren, being able to read wiring diagrams — that's valuable in this department.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation. Slight pause after the name. Low-key approval that lands because it's rare and honest. Not warming up — settling into a real thought.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。社内を一周する見学、勉強になりました。
lines.en: Yes. The tour around the whole operation was really instructive.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude. Slight formality but genuine — he means it. Careful breath at the start, like he's conscious of the respect between them. Not eager-to-please, but present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクトの進め方、自分でも考えろ。
lines.en: Think through how the project should flow on your own too.
lines.style: Measured directive. Not harsh — the tone of someone who believes you can do it. Slight emphasis on 「自分でも」 as encouragement, not skepticism. Hands him the responsibility like it's something he can hold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。部品の納入経路、興味深いです。
lines.en: Yes. The supply routes for parts — it's really interesting how it all connects.
lines.style: Genuine interest underneath the formality. He's noticing real things, not just trying to impress. Slight vocal lean forward on 「興味深い」 — he's actually engaged. Warm but contained.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 現職員の意見、若いうちから聞け。
lines.en: Listen to the opinions of people who've been here longer. Start that habit now, while you're young.
lines.style: Steady instruction. Weight of experience without condescension. He's not warning him — he's suggesting a path. Slight slowness that implies this matters. Eye-contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 就活前、心構え、教えていただきたいです。
lines.en: Before you start job hunting, I'd like you to think about how to approach it.
lines.style: Careful vulnerability underneath the politeness. He's asking for something real, not performing deference. Slight hesitation on 「心構え」 — admitting he wants guidance. Respectful but direct.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 起業を立ち上がる、若手、出てきている。
lines.en: Young people are starting their own ventures now. It's a different landscape.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly distant. Not quite to himself, but thinking aloud. Measured pace. He's positioning this as context, not criticism or judgment. Something shifting in what he knows.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。複数案件に取り組ませる経験、ありがたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I'm really grateful for the chance to work on multiple projects like this.
lines.style: Sincere closing gratitude. Warmth underneath the formality — he's felt the mentorship. Full attention in the voice. Not rushing, but wrapping a genuine moment. Small exhale of relief at the end.
